points.description: Names the convolutional layer(s) with kernels/filters convolving over the input image, followed by an activation layer (e.g. ReLU).
Names a pooling layer (max or average pooling) and then one or more fully connected layers ending in a softmax (output) layer. Equivalent wording accepted.
points.partial_credit: Half if only the pooling layer or only the fully connected/softmax part is given.
